message.content: I don’t have direct access to the list of software installed on your system, so I can’t tell you which packages are at version 5.5. If you can provide the output of a package‑manager query (e.g., `dpkg -l | grep 5.5`, `pip list`, `brew list --versions`, etc.) I can help you interpret it.
